item.title: Microsoft’s 25th anniversary Xbox will cost $899
item.summary: The special-edition translucent green Xbox finally has an official price. Preorders for the console start August 27th at 10AM ET / 7AM PT, although Microsoft says "some of XBOX's most dedicated fans" will receive early access preorder emails starting today.
